labels.species: P. aeruginosa; strains ATCC 27853, PAO1, FADDI-PA022
labels.record_level: Strain-level MIC records; replicate count and individual-versus-summary measurement status NOT_FOUND.
labels.reason: Body cells provide PMB MIC values of 1 mg/L for each of three named P. aeruginosa strains, supporting susceptibility classification, source provenance and units under DR001 and DR002. For DR024, susceptibility inputs are AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE only for their stated P. aeruginosa context; matched K. pneumoniae susceptibility coverage remains UNRESOLVED. The source expressly excludes both K. pneumoniae MIC identity and a PK sample-to-strain linkage. It does not support a DR020 panel–regimen–strain–MIC–response match or K. pneumoniae target estimation. MIC testing conditions and replicate or summary definitions are unspecified.

findings.reason: MI001, Mouse panel-to-regimen matching, remains AMBIGUOUS with resolution_status OPEN and needed_at prepare; origin main:/missing_information/items/0. Impact: Mouse panels cannot be treated as matched regimen-level exposure-response records without verification. F0003:S1:T34:A667 explicitly states that these are P. aeruginosa MICs, not K. pneumoniae MICs and not a PK sample-to-strain linkage. This page therefore does not resolve DR020. The dependent matching decision remains pending; this finding does not block independent PK work.
findings.needed_material: Verify the panel, regimen, strain-MIC and response associations required by SC032, documenting supported matches and unresolved links.

findings.reason: Three P. aeruginosa strain identities and their PMB MIC values are available in F0003:S1:T34:A669:C671. The reviewed page does not specify susceptibility method, medium, testing standard, replicate count or summary definition. It provides no matched K. pneumoniae MIC or regimen–exposure–response relationship. These are page-scoped unresolved inputs, not proof that the information is absent elsewhere.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported MIC testing context and replicate or summary definitions; for K. pneumoniae index analysis, matched K. pneumoniae strain MICs and traceable links to the intended response and exposure records.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T34:A667 identifies pulmonary-study P. aeruginosa susceptibility data. Retain these records in their stated organism and source context; their downstream supporting or benchmark destination requires independent review. They cannot supply K. pneumoniae MICs or set K. pneumoniae efficacy targets.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of an appropriate supporting or benchmark destination, preserving S05 provenance and the explicit organism and linkage limitations.
